title: Delivery Times, Cut-Off and Statements Across the Payout Methods Rails
content:
Funds sent to a Payout Methods rail arrive within the rail's processing time, counted in business days on the rail's business-day calendar. A processing time of 0 business days means the funds arrive within the same day.

## Delivery figures by rail

| Rail | Processing time (business days from transfer to arrival) | Arrives within minutes | Sent on weekends and holidays | Trace reference for a sent transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | 5 | No | No | Available |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | 0 (same day) | Yes | Yes | Not available |
| PayPal | 1 | No | No | Available |
| Payoneer | 2 | No | No | Available |
| International Wire Transfer | 7 | No | No | Available |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | 1 | No | No | Not available |

## Terms common to every rail

| Item | Every rail |
|---|---|
| Calendar that defines business days | US Federal Reserve holiday calendar |
| Cut-off time | 17:00 US Eastern on business days; a transfer after the cut-off starts the next business day |
| Earnings statement | A monthly earnings statement on the first business day of the month |

## Points of reference

- **Same-day rail.** Fast Pay Debit Card is the only rail with a processing time of 0 business days; its funds arrive within minutes, and it is the only rail that sends on weekends and holidays.
- **Longest processing time.** International Wire Transfer, at 7 business days.
- **Trace references.** A trace reference for a sent transfer is available on Direct Deposit (ACH), PayPal, Payoneer and International Wire Transfer, and is not available on Fast Pay Debit Card or Western Union Cash Pickup.

**Hypothetical counting example.** An imagined PayPal transfer sent before 17:00 US Eastern on a Tuesday that is a business day, with no holiday that week, arrives within 1 business day, that is, by Wednesday. The same transfer sent at 18:00 US Eastern that Tuesday starts on Wednesday, the next business day, and arrives within 1 business day of it, by Thursday.
